heading: **12 January 2026**
body:
*lig70N PCR*

Concentration of this annealed lig70Nw107 \= \~3 ug/uL

Dilute this DNA to get an estimated 5 ng/uL concentration DNA solution.

Prepare a 10X reaction mix:

| Reagent | Volume (µL) |
| ----- | ----- |
| **ligN40w107 Ann** | **10** |
| **Phusion Master Mix** | **125** |
| **NCAP\_F (10 µM)** | **12.5** |
| **NCAP\_R (10 uM)** | **12.5** |
| **Water** | **90**  |
| **Total** | **250** |

Split mix into 25 uL per well for two 96-well PCR plates.

| 98°C | 3 min |
| :---- | :---- |
| 98°C | 10 s |
| 55°C | 15 s       **8X\*** |
| 72°C | 30 s |
| 72°C | 40 min |
| 4°C | HOLD |

Pool the PCR product and run 20 uL of sample on a 1% agarose gel. Measure concentration of the PCR1 product.

Upon running this PCR product on a 2% agarose gel no product was seen.

This suggested too much dilution of the initial annealed PCR product. 

I then ran another PCR with just 10-fold dilution of the original annealed product and this yielded a product of the right size but also retained the shorter annealed fragments.
title: lig70N PCR
